name: Padjelantaleden Etapp 1: Ritsem/STF Akka Fjällstuga - BLT Gisurisstugan
description: Ritsem / Änonjálmme / STF Akka Fjällstuga to BLT Gisuris/Kisurisstugan. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Route geometry is the walking leg from the Akka/Änonjálmme side toward Gisuris. Ritsem access requires M/S Storlule or private boat across Akkajaure and is not walking geometry.
Timing note: Boat schedules, wind cancellations, and staying at Ritsem or Akka can dominate the access day.

facilities.name: STF Ritsem Fjällstation
facilities.description: Road-side access base before the Akkajaure crossing. STF lists accommodation, cafe/shop-style services, parking, Wi-Fi, and EV charging. Open season found for 2026 was 2026-06-18 to 2026-09-06.
facilities.routeProximity: road-side access hub before boat; not on walking geometry

facilities.name: Ritsem hamn / M/S Storlule terminal
facilities.description: Departure point for M/S Storlule over Akkajaure toward Änonjálmme/Áhkká and Vájsáluokta.
facilities.routeProximity: about 0.5 km from STF Ritsem; boat leg to walking start

facilities.name: Änonjálmme / Áhkká landing
facilities.description: Boat landing and practical walking trailhead for the stage after the Akkajaure crossing.

facilities.name: STF Akka Fjällstuga / Áhkká
facilities.description: STF self-catering mountain hut about 2 km from Änonjálmme. STF notes water is fetched locally, hut routines include chopping wood/cleaning, Telia GSM may be available, security room/help-phone context exists, and the sauna is permanently closed. Open season found for 2026 was 2026-06-26 to 2026-09-06.
facilities.routeProximity: on route, official intermediate start for Akka-Gisuris component

facilities.name: BLT Gisuris/Kisurisstugan
facilities.description: BLT hut camp at the stage end. BLT lists 34 beds and one year-round cabin; general BLT hut information includes hosts/provisions/gas cooking/dry toilets. Field reports caution that provisions can be very limited and should not be relied on as a guaranteed resupply.
